card_name: ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card
fee_details:
- Joining fee: Nil
- Annual fee (from the second year onwards): Nil
- Fee for add-on card: Nil
- Overdue interest on card arrears and extended credit: 240Rs. every month
joining_perks: Receive 2 PAYBACK Points when you spend Rs.100 on retail purchases.
reward_structure:
- Receive 2 PAYBACK Points when you spend Rs.100 on retail purchases.
- You will get 1% fuel surcharge waiver on fuel expenditure that is Rs. 400 and above at HPCL petrol pumps.
- Save up to 15% more on dine-out experiences with the ICICI Bank Culinary Treats programme.
key_highlights:
- Receive 2 PAYBACK Points when you spend Rs.100 on retail purchases.
- You will get 1% fuel surcharge waiver on fuel expenditure that is Rs. 400 and above at HPCL petrol pumps.
- Save up to 15% more on dine-out experiences with the ICICI Bank Culinary Treats programme.

benefits_features.Welcome Benefits: The ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card can earn you PAYBACK Points on every transaction that you make. PAYBACK has been placed in India’s largest Reward Programme. With ICICI credit cards you get a points reward or surprise rewards from your expenditures.
benefits_features.Spending Benefits: You will earn 1 PAYBACK Points every time you spend Rs.100. Rs.100 spent represents fuel for taxis.
benefits_features.Fuel Benefits: Avail 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all transactions that amount to Rs.400 at all HPCL pumps when the ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card is swiped on any ICICI Merchant Services machine.
benefits_features.Dining Benefits: You can save around 15% while dining with the ICICI Bank Culinary Treats programme in more than 2,500 restaurants. These are spread across 12 cities in India.

reward_point_benefits: PAYBACK Points can be redeemed from a list of options. These include travel vouchers, products, movie vouchers, appliances, mobiles, and lots more.
miscellaneous:
To be eligible for the ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card, you need to be above 23 years of age.
Documents Required to Apply for ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card:
You will have to submit the following documents to apply for the card:
1. Income Proof
    a. Form 16
    b.I.T Return
    c.Salary Slip
2. Identity Proof
    a.Driving Licence
    b.Passport
    c.Aadhaar card
3. Proof of Address
    a.Passport
    b.Voter ID
    c.Aadhaar card
The documents mentioned are indicative. The bank may ask you to submit other documents.

faqs.Are there any dining benefits for other: Yes, you can easily save about 15% on all your dining experiences with the ICICI Bank Culinary Treats programme. This can be used at more than 2500 restaurants in India.
faqs.What is the joining fee for the ICICI Ba: You don’t have to pay any joining fee to get this credit card.
faqs.What documents are required to apply for: You will need to submit either your passport, driving license, or Aadhaar card as proof of identity for this credit card.
faqs.Why do I need the ICICI Bank Platinum Ch: The ICICI Bank Credit Card comes with a security chip. This chip protects all users against fraud and also gives you a Personal Identification Number which is an extra layer of security.
